data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'atefeh' meaning noble, precious, or exalted. In Islamic culture, it symbolizes the noble character and virtues of a Muslim woman. The name Atefeh carries the meaning “Noble One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Atefeh usually hope their child will grow to embody noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Atefeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atefeh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

It is a name that resonates with the pride and value placed on the role and representation of women in Islamic societies. The name exudes elegance, beauty, and grace, reflecting the high regard for the feminine form and its importance in the global Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Atefeh' is deeply rooted in spiritual meaning, symbolizing the noble and precious soul of a Muslim woman in her continual pursuit of excellence in accordance with Islamic values. It is a reminder of the innate worth and dignity that comes directly from God, as stated in the Quran, "And We have honored the sons of Adam, and We carry them on land and seas. We have given them preferences over most things We have created, with [definite] preference" [Quran 17:70]. The name bestows upon its bearer a sense of responsibility to continually strive towards spiritual growth and to embody the nobility and grace bestowed upon her as a reflection of the Creator.
